rationale: Main variant of spice.wsp: the law of docs/wsp/research/phys_spice_w0.md section 7.4 typed verbatim. Its smoke-point length uses the investigators' published fit of the same smoke points (Dotson et al. 2011), so for T1 it is not a blind forecast; the flame-length law and the soot probability are the author's. Source: docs/wsp/research/phys_spice_w0.md. Transcribed by the assembly engineer (claude-opus-5-5); no number chosen, rounded or changed.
